source_name: Службен весник на РСМ — архивирани изданија (Official Gazette, archived issues)
why_relevant: Legally mandated publication venue for Assembly and Government decisions appointing/dismissing the NBRNM Governor, Vice-Governors and Council members, Securities Commission president/commissioners, and insurance/pension supervisor bodies. Date-stamped, authoritative, non-repudiable. Search result confirmed an appointment decision PDF for a National Bank governor (Anita Angelovska-Bezhoska, 2018) hosted under /Issues/.

source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Соопштенија (NBRNM press releases)
why_relevant: Primary channel where the central bank itself announces governor/vice-governor swearing-in, Council composition changes, and senior management news. Bilingual site (mk/en mirrors with -en.nspx suffix).

source_name: НБРСМ — Гувернер / Governor page
why_relevant: Canonical current-incumbent page; diffing it detects a governor change and gives official biography/mandate dates. English mirror at /guverner-en.nspx.

source_name: НБРСМ — Членови на Советот на НБРСМ / National Bank Council members
why_relevant: Lists the nine-member Council (Governor + 3 Vice-Governors executive, 5 non-executive) with mandates; the single best structured view of the top supervisory personnel layer. Mandates are 7 years (Art. 49 Law on the NBRM), so expiries are predictable and diffable.

source_name: НБРСМ — Организациона шема (organisational chart)
why_relevant: Shows directorate structure (incl. Дирекција за платни системи, supervision directorates). Structural diffs are the leading indicator asked for in the cell rationale — e.g. creation/renaming of a payment-systems or fintech/oversight unit.

source_name: НБРСМ — Конкурси (NBRNM vacancies/competitions)
why_relevant: Central bank's own hiring notices — the most direct A5 jobs signal for the regulator, and job titles reveal which supervisory/payment-systems capabilities are being built out before any org chart changes.

source_name: Собрание на РСМ — official Assembly website (decisions, sessions, elections & appointments)
why_relevant: The Assembly is the legal appointing body for the NBRNM Governor (on President's proposal), Vice-Governors (on Governor's proposal), non-executive Council members (on Government's proposal), the Securities Commission president/commissioners and the insurance/pension supervisors' expert councils. Session agendas and decisions are the earliest official trace.

source_name: Собрание — Комисија за прашања на изборите и именувањата (Committee on Elections and Appointments)
why_relevant: This committee vets every regulator appointment before the plenary vote — its agenda is a 1-3 week LEADING indicator of who will be appointed to NBRNM Council, KHV, ASO, MAPAS.

source_name: Влада на РСМ — јавни огласи за именување (Government public calls for appointment)
why_relevant: Confirmed example: 'Јавен оглас за именување неизвршен член на Советот на Народна банка'. The Government publishes the open call BEFORE proposing a candidate to the Assembly — the earliest legally mandated public signal of an NBRNM Council vacancy. Same channel used for agency director calls.

source_name: Влада на РСМ — соопштенија од владини седници (Government session decisions)
why_relevant: Government sessions adopt the appointment/dismissal decisions for agency directors and the proposals for parliamentary appointments; per-session releases enumerate names and institutions.

source_name: Комисија за хартии од вредност на РСМ (Securities and Exchange Commission) — organisational structure
why_relevant: KHV president and commissioners are elected/dismissed by the Assembly on Government proposal. Page carries current roster (search results indicate president Bujare Abazi, internal commissioner Vasko Pejkov, external commissioners Dean Stojanovski, Kiril Jovanovski, Zoran Kolev) plus department structure.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Сектор за финансиски систем (Ministry of Finance, Financial System Sector)
why_relevant: This is exactly the banking-and-payments policy unit in the cell scope: its remit covers banking system, non-bank financial institutions, capital market, insurance, accounting/audit and payment operations. The page names the sector head (Ivan Nedev) and assistant head (Ornela Trajkoska Pendevska) with contact details — a diffable personnel roster.

source_name: Агенција за администрација (Agency for Administration) — public vacancy announcements
why_relevant: By law, civil-service posts in the Ministry of Finance and other state bodies are filled through a Јавен оглас published by the Agency for Administration. Titles and grades reveal capacity building in banking/payments policy units before any leadership announcement.

source_name: Агенција за супервизија на осигурување (ASO) — За нас / governing Council of Experts
why_relevant: Adjacent financial supervisor; its Совет на експерти (president + 4 members) is appointed by the Assembly, same legal pipeline as NBRNM Council. Current president Eli Drakulovska, five-year mandate from 27 Dec 2024 (per search results) — gives a known mandate-expiry anchor.

source_name: МАПАС — Agency for Supervision of Fully Funded Pension Insurance, MAPAS Bodies
why_relevant: Third Assembly-appointed financial supervisor; roster page names the Council of Experts (chairman Maksud Ali; members Mentor Jakupi, Darko Sazdov per search results). Useful for the same appointment pipeline and for tracking cross-agency personnel rotation.

source_name: Фонд за осигурување на депозити (Deposit Insurance Fund) — Staff / Fund's Profile
why_relevant: Statutory bank-safety-net body under Ministry of Finance/Government oversight; its staff page names director and division heads (e.g. CEO Manuchehr Asoev; heads of legal and PR divisions per search results), giving a rare named mid-management roster in the MK financial supervision cluster.

source_name: Национален совет за платните системи (National Payment Systems Council), NBRNM
why_relevant: Cross-institutional payments governance body chaired from the NBRNM; its membership list maps who holds payment-systems authority across NBRNM, Ministry of Finance, banks and card schemes — the exact 'payment-systems director' signal the cell rationale calls a leading indicator.

source_name: Faktor.mk — banking/finance personnel coverage
why_relevant: Business daily that reliably reports regulator appointments before/around the official act, often naming the candidate and background (e.g. reported the incoming NBRNM vice-governor replacing Barjami, and the new KHV leadership). Useful as an early-warning tripwire pointing back to the primary act.

source_name: МИА (Media Information Agency) — state news agency, parliamentary/committee announcements
why_relevant: State news agency publishes НАЈАВА (advance notice) items for Assembly committee sessions including the Elections and Appointments Committee — a practical, fetchable substitute when sobranie.mk blocks automated access.

source_name: Meta.mk — tag feed 'Комисија за прашања на изборите и именувањата'
why_relevant: Ready-made topical tag archive that aggregates every story about the appointments committee — an efficient pointer for backfilling historical appointment rounds and discovering additional actors/terms.

source_name: Time.mk — Macedonian news aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregates essentially the whole MK media market in one searchable index; the fastest way to sweep all outlets for an appointment story and snowball to outlets not yet in the source list (24.mk, denesen.mk, skopje1.mk, nezavisen.mk, biznisvesti.mk, makfax, libertas, MRT all surfaced this way).

source_name: Википедија (mk/en) — Народна банка на Македонија / Комисија за хартии од вредност
why_relevant: Not authoritative, but an excellent actor-map and succession-list scaffold (historical governors, legal appointment mechanics, article references to the Law on the NBRM) and a source of citation links back to primary acts.

source_name: Central Banking — National Bank of North Macedonia organisation page
why_relevant: Specialist international central-banking trade publication that covers governor appointments, reappointments and senior central-bank moves in English — useful for corroboration and for international framing of an MK appointment.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (Central Registry) — main portal / Трговски регистар
why_relevant: Statutory company register of North Macedonia. Every change of управител/овластено лице and of членови на управен и надзорен одбор of a bank, e-money institution or payment institution must be filed here. Legally compelled, exhaustive record of organisation and leadership change, including moves never announced by PR.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Основен профил на регистриран субјект (free basic profile / open data)
why_relevant: Free public lookup by EMBS or name returning basic registration data including authorised representative(s). Cheapest recurring way to detect a signatory/manager change at a licensed entity.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Потврда за историјат на промени за субјект
why_relevant: Certificate listing the full history of registered changes for an entity — the authoritative back-run of leadership/signatory changes for a bank or payment institution, useful for backfilling a tenure timeline rather than only forward monitoring.
